blocks.text: The Zscaler and AWS Deployment Guide provides instructions on integrating Internet & SaaS (ZIA), Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Deception, Unified Vulnerability Management (UVM), and other Zscaler products with Amazon Web Services (AWS) such as Snowball Edge, S3, CloudWatch, Amazon Q, GuardDuty, etc.

AWS is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud, offering over 200 fully featured services from data centers globally. Millions of organizations use AWS to lower costs, become more agile, and innovate faster.

This guide helps AWS users enable and deploy Internet & SaaS, Private Access, Deception, UVM, and other Zscaler products for AWS tenants. After configuring AWS to work with the Zscaler service, AWS traffic passes through the Zscaler cloud, and the Zscaler service enforces security policies on AWS traffic.
For more information on AWS as a Zscaler partner, see the AWS partner page.
